asi.interpretation: Candidate latency was lower than the behavioral baseline, but the single comparison is noisy and does not establish a retained optimization.

asi.change: Moved remote WAL writes out of the global BATCH_BUFFERS mutex in flush_all_buffers.
asi.result: Latency regressed by 0.869 ms from the candidate reference run and remote delivery latency regressed by 23.34 ms; source change reverted.
asi.next: The canonical profile flushes each 60-record request at the 50-record threshold, so timeout-only changes cannot improve its primary metric. Investigate per-request pipeline execution costs or add a workload whose batches stay below the flush threshold before revisiting timer changes.

asi.change: Moved the final fan-out receiver out of send_to_children' clone loop, eliminating one PipelineItem clone per fan-out.
asi.result: Client latency regressed by 0.844 ms against the behavioral baseline despite higher throughput; source change reverted.
asi.next: The cloned record is required by each branch, and removing one clone does not improve the canonical latency profile. Profile or reduce per-invocation task/channel setup before considering another fan-out micro-optimization.
